summary: The initial P1 union is closed, but nested lifetime enqueueing would deadlock migration transitions that await rebasePromise.

findings.title: Nested recovery enqueue deadlocks migration transitions
findings.remediation: Make the startup settlement/rebase body itself the single enqueued lifetime transition and run recovery inline within it.

findings.title: Retired creator-close handle must be stopped after successful rebind
findings.remediation: Stop the predecessor close handle after installing the successful rebind.

findings.title: Store parser must include safe, strictly increasing times and canonical limits
findings.remediation: Pin the structural time and canonical round-trip rules plus a negative RED control.

findings.title: Node-versus-store lastLogicalTime ownership needs reconciliation
findings.remediation: State that store-side signed-commit derivation supersedes only the prior Node derivation sentence while Node remains assembly/admission authority.
